Extend plugins/dso/hooks/pre-commit-compliance-verifier.sh (created by story 1283) with the full step list.

## PREREQUISITE
File is created by story 1283 which must be merged before this story executes.

## Changes
1. Replace static list ["lint"] with ["test", "format", "lint", "classifier-dispatch", "reviewer-record"]
2. Loop logic per step: if <name>.result present → pass; if <name>.timeout present → exit 1 with timeout message; if neither → exit 1 with missing-artifact message
3. Enabled condition: use read-config.sh (not raw grep) to read hooks.compliance_verifier.enabled:
   ENABLED=$(bash "$REPO_ROOT/.claude/scripts/dso" read-config.sh hooks.compliance_verifier.enabled 2>/dev/null)
   [[ "$ENABLED" != "true" ]] && exit 0
4. ARTIFACTS_DIR resolution: get_artifacts_dir() from deps.sh (unchanged from 1283)
5. First-run guard (ARTIFACTS_DIR absent → pass-with-warning) unchanged

## No chmod needed (file already has +x from 1283)

GREEN — make T1 tests pass.
